name: Owain Llewellyn
bio:
Owain Llewellyn's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After a decade as a local newspaper reporter covering village fetes and council meetings in rural Wales, a chance encounter at a hill climb event sparked a passion. He quickly realized the power of storytelling in motorsport and its potential to captivate a wider audience. Owain believes in crafting narratives that resonate with fans on an emotional level, highlighting the human element behind the speed and technology.

His approach centers on authenticity and building genuine relationships with drivers, teams, and media outlets. Owain has a knack for identifying unique angles and turning them into compelling stories, ensuring maximum exposure for his clients. He distinguishes himself through his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to navigate complex situations with grace and diplomacy. Owain aims to elevate the profile of any racing organization he represents by celebrating its history, its people, and the exciting future.

physical.hairStyle: Thinning on top, neatly combed to the side
physical.description: A man of medium build, Owain often sports a tweed jacket and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Dylan Thomas's poetry.
Insists on brewing his own tea using a specific Welsh water source he imports.
Starts every press release with a historical anecdote, regardless of its relevance.
